bob.name: Bay of Bengal
bob.summary: Most numerical models (ECMWF HRES, NCEP-GFS, DWD ICON, CMC GEM, NOAA AIGFS) are indicating the formation of a low pressure system over southeast BoB around 22 October, while DWD ICON indicates formation over eastcentral BoB. All of them indicate intensification into a depression around 22–23 October, and ECMWF HRES, NCEP-GFS, DWD ICON, CMC GEM, NOAA AIGFS further into a cyclonic storm (ECMWF HRES up to VSCS). Regarding movement, they indicate movement towards the Andhra Pradesh coast (NCEP-GFS, DWD ICON, NOAA AIGFS) and towards the Odisha coast (CMC GEM), while ECMWF HRES keeps it over the sea till the end of the forecast. EC-AIFS does not indicate any significant system. Thus there is considerable uncertainty regarding the formation, intensification and subsequent track of the potential system. Ensemble guidance: ECMWF ENS 100%, AIFS ENS 100%, NCEP GEFS 100% of members show a system.

arab.name: Arabian Sea
arab.summary: Various numerical models (ECMWF HRES, DWD ICON) are indicating the formation of a low pressure system over southeast AS around 28 October, while DWD ICON indicates formation over eastcentral AS. All of them indicate intensification into a depression around 28 October. No model brings it to the coast within its forecast period. EC-AIFS, NCEP-GFS, NOAA AIGFS, CMC GEM do not indicate any significant system. Thus there is considerable uncertainty regarding the formation, intensification and subsequent track of the potential system. Ensemble guidance: ECMWF ENS 76%, AIFS ENS 65%, NCEP GEFS 23% of members show a system.

legend: ECMWF: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (IFS HRES); NCEP GFS: National Centers for Environmental Prediction Global Forecast System; DWD ICON: Deutscher Wetterdienst ICON global model; CMC GEM: Canadian Meteorological Centre GDPS; EC-AIFS: ECMWF Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System; NOAA AIGFS: NOAA AI Global Forecast System; ECMWF ENS / AIFS ENS / NCEP GEFS / NOAA AIGEFS: ensembles of the same centres. LPA: Low Pressure Area, WML: Well Marked Low, D: Depression, DD: Deep Depression, CS: Cyclonic Storm, SCS: Severe CS, VSCS: Very Severe CS, ESCS: Extremely Severe CS, SuCS: Super CS. Times are DD/HH in UTC (e.g. 22/12 = 22nd, 1200 UTC).
